message: A contractor says your quote includes an "NOA" door, and you nod along. What is it, exactly? It's the county paperwork for one specific door model, and it lists things like the manufacturer, size limits, pressure ratings and an expiration date. There's also a permanent label on the door itself, so a flashlight and a phone photo can get you started. Here's how to read the approval and which questions to ask before you sign.
